what: Diagnosis: the two calls of 02 and 02b failed together each time. Retry the origin witness alone (HUD Retry = retryWitness(0,0)); chapter 1 stays failed meanwhile (its card waits for Retry). Wait for the witness (up to 4 min) and read what was written

actions.eval: (async () => { const W = await import('/app/land/witness.ts'); window.__w0 = Date.now(); W.retryWitness({ cx: 0, cz: 0 }); return 'retry' })()

repeat.until: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const c = S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['0,0']; return c !== undefined && c.status !== 'writing' })()

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const c = S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['0,0']; return JSON.stringify({ ms: Date.now() - window.__w0, status: c?.status, error: c?.status === 'failed' ? c.error : null, name: c?.scene?.name ?? null, residents: c?.scene?.npcs?.map(n => n.name + ' (' + n.role + ')') ?? null }) })()
